liebermann.notes: Paper; from the Tripartita, f. 1 ECf retr with Rubricator II from 9 on (beginning torn away), then the Genealogia Normannica; readings closest to L. Followed by a Southwark tract De fundatoribus ecclesiarum and a French romance.

entries.text_de:
Dublin Trinity College E 5, 2016, Papier, um 1475. [Aus Tripartita:] f. 1 ECf retr mit Rubricator II von 9 ab, u. S. 633 Anm. 17, Anfang fortgerissen. Dann Geneal. Norm. Die Lesarten sind L nächst verwandt.

[Es folgen der Tractat eines dem Diceto folgenden Southwarkers De fundatoribus ecclesiarum17 und der Roman von rex in Norfolchia Castor18.]
entries.text_en:
Dublin, Trinity College E 5, 2016, paper, c. 1475. [From Tripartita:] f. 1 ECf retr with Rubricator II from 9 onward, below, p. 633 n. 17, the beginning torn away. Then Geneal. Norm. The readings are most closely related to L.

[There follow the treatise of a Southwark writer following Diceto, De fundatoribus ecclesiarum17, and the romance of rex in Norfolchia Castor18.]

notes.text_de: vgl. Abbott Catalogue of the mss. in Trinity Coll. n. 632; Liebermann Über Leges ECf. p. 129.
notes.text_en: cf. Abbott, Catalogue of the mss. in Trinity Coll. no. 632; Liebermann, Über Leges ECf. p. 129.

notes.text_de: Hierzu nannte mir Herr Prof. Suchier eine Französische Version bei K. Sachs Beitr. zur Kunde Altfranzös. Literatur (1857) p. 47—52.
notes.text_en: For this Prof. Suchier pointed me to a French version in K. Sachs, Beitr. zur Kunde Altfranzös. Literatur (1857) p. 47—52.

transcription.doubts: Skipped at top of col. 1, p. xxiii: the end of the D entry ("19 Anfang. 23 Anfang. 13. 14 Anfang … D copirte Liber Oxon. Cradok, diesen Vs."), which belongs to the previous reader. Words such as 'Dublin Trinity' appear letter-spaced, apparently only to justify the line; not marked as Sperrdruck.
proof_notes: n. 18: 'Suchier' is letter-spaced (Sperrdruck), now marked spaced (p. xxiii)
